title: Request Surface Prioritizer for Hosted Chat Streaming + Toolchains
creator: Sana Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit a wide variety of hosted API requests (chat + streaming, tool/function calling chains, and structured output contracts). Current intake is manual and inconsistent: teams struggle to (1) prioritize work against SLAs, revenue impact, and security constraints, and (2) reliably recommend rollout/fallback strategies for streaming toolchains and structured outputs.

Goal: Build a deterministic 'request-surface prioritizer' that scores inbound feature requests and returns an actionable lane (Fast-track / Evaluate / Needs Security Review / Low priority) plus recommended rollout templates (canary, tenant gating, fallback to non-streaming variant). The scorer should be explainable (weights visible to reviewers) and automatable inside the intake form and enterprise concierge flow.

Scope: MVP will support hosted-chat streaming + multi-action toolchains + structured outputs (JSON schemas). It must consume signals: SLA requested, estimated ARR or contract size, security classification, compliance requirements (e.g., SOC2/HIPAA), technical complexity estimate, customer urgency, and existing model/runtime compatibility. Output is a score and one of four lanes, plus recommended first steps and contact owner.

Non-goals: Full automation of security/architecture approvals, scheduling for Dedicated or Private deployments, or automatic commit of roadmap entries (these remain manual after handoff).
acceptance_criteria: Inbound intake form maps required fields to scorer inputs and returns a score within 2s for submitted requests
Scorer returns one of: Fast-track, Evaluate (PM-led), Security Review Required, Low priority
Recommendations include: required rollout template (canary/A-B/fallback), suggested SLA tier, and a minimal checklist for compliance and data classification
Explainability UI: weight breakdown visible in intake review; PM can override with reason logged
Integration hooks: webhook to create PM ticket + labels, and flag to route to concierge for enterprise sales teams
Documentation and example flows added to Confluence with two worked examples (streaming toolchain for CRM integration; structured-output schema onboarding for invoicing agent)
